what_resolved_means: Closed from the shop's side: everything the shop could do today has been done and no further action is available to it. It does not claim the customer has their goods. Where something is still outstanding it is named in `still_outstanding` and in the ticket's own notes.

tickets.subject: Bulldog tee
tickets.outcome: Closed from the shop's side. Invoice 501 was approved and paid in full, so Bulldog Print Co is no longer blocked from shipping. CC-TEE-WHITE size S is still at zero and no reprint was ordered, because the shop has no tool for placing a vendor order and only $160.00 of cash remains. Tauhid has not received a tee.
tickets.still_outstanding: A reprint of CC-TEE-WHITE size S was never ordered, so the tee has not reached the customer.

cash_effect.what: Payment #1 - invoice 501 to Bulldog Print Co, approved and paid in full

agent_contributions.boss: Read the ticket and the balance, asked Inventory why the tee could not be sent, then asked Accounting whether the blocking invoice could be afforded. Closed the ticket only after the owner's payment went through, writing the unfinished work into its notes.
agent_contributions.inventory: Found CC-TEE-WHITE size S at 0 units against the 1 requested, and traced the cause: Bulldog Print Co is blocked from shipping until overdue invoice 501 is settled. Checked the vendor's status and lead time rather than assuming.
agent_contributions.accounting: Weighed invoice 501 ($840.00, 3 days overdue) against the $2,400.00 rent competing for the same balance, confirmed $3,400.00 covered both with $160.00 to spare, and raised payment approval APR-9B40C55B. Paid nothing itself.

tickets.subject: Rent due
tickets.outcome: Closed. Rent of $2,400.00 was verified against lease 1, approved by the owner and paid in full on the shop's date. Nothing further is owed on this notice.

cash_effect.what: Payment #2 - one month of rent on lease 1 to Elm City Properties, approved and paid in full

agent_contributions.boss: Treated the landlord's 'due in 2 days' as a claim to check, not a fact. Asked Facilities to establish what the lease actually says, then Accounting whether it was affordable alongside the invoice.
agent_contributions.facilities: Read the lease record instead of the email: $2,400.00 on lease 1, due 2026-09-02 against a shop date of 2026-08-31 - two days out and not yet overdue, so the landlord's wording was accurate.
agent_contributions.accounting: Confirmed the rent still fitted once the $840.00 invoice was counted, leaving $160.00, and raised payment approval APR-09122CCE. Paid nothing itself.

tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount
tickets.outcome: Closed from the shop's side. The owner approved $46.00 per unit for 20 hoodies - below the $58.00 list price, above the $22.00 unit cost, leaving $480.00 of total margin - and the stored list price was left untouched. Only 8 of the 20 are on hand and the shop cannot place a restock order, so the Yale AI Club has an agreed price rather than twenty hoodies.
tickets.still_outstanding: 12 of the 20 hoodies are not in stock and were not ordered, so the agreed price covers an order the shop cannot yet supply in full.

cash_effect.what: No payment. The price override was approved, but agreeing what to charge is not a purchase and moves no cash. Nothing in this shop brings money in, either.

agent_contributions.boss: Sent the discount question to Customer Service, who own anything a customer reads, and closed the ticket after the owner decided - recording that the price was settled but the stock was not.
agent_contributions.customer_service: Pulled the real numbers - $22.00 unit cost against $58.00 list - and proposed $46.00, which still holds a $24.00 margin per unit. Raised price-override approval APR-7ABAA5BF for the owner rather than changing any price, checked stock and found only 8 of 20 on hand, and saved customer draft DRAFT-52BEBA without sending it.
